name: soap-studio-linen
material: matte oat-coloured soap with a fine grain, a bevel on all four top edges, and a debossed circular stamp on the upper face
detail: the stamp is 18 mm across and 1.5 mm deep, with a faint soap dust caught in the lettering
label: none
scene: A working ceramics studio in the late afternoon, a plaster workbench with a scatter of dried clay dust, unglazed test tiles stacked at the back, and a deep window at camera-left with a linen blind half drawn. Background falls away at 2 m.

placement.angle: one corner toward the lens, long edge receding
placement.behind: a stack of unglazed test tiles

sharp: the stamped face and the bevel along the near edge
falloff: the window and the tiles at the back
light: Key: a low afternoon window from camera-left, softened by the linen blind, 4300 K, raking across the bench so the bevel reads as a line. Fill: a white card at camera-right, 60 cm out, lifting the shadow side without flattening the bevel. Rim: none. Practicals: none. Falloff: the back wall goes two stops down.
atmosphere: Visible clay dust suspended in the window beam, settling slowly. No haze on the lens, no droplets.

motion_layers.name: dust drift
motion_layers.rule: eight to twelve motes; none crosses the stamped face

motion_layers.name: blind sway
motion_layers.direction: the linen edge breathing in the window draught
motion_layers.rule: the key light direction and the bevel highlight do not change

extra_guardrails: The stamp stays legible at thumbnail size.
The soap reads as soap and never as stone or cheese.
